title: DUO-THERM: FURNACE:RECREATIONAL VEHICLE (43,643 affected)
summary: GAS CONTROL MAY FAIL TO COMPLETELY CLOSE RESULTING IN GAS FLOW THROUGH TO THE OUTSIDE VENT OF THE FURNACE.

title: Volvo Trucks North America: BRAKES:HYDRAULIC:FITTINGS:METALLIC (4,408 affected)
summary: THE BRAKE LINE BETWEEN THE PROPORTIONING VALVE AND THE REAR WHEEL BRAKE MAY FRACTURE.

title: Volvo Trucks North America: STRUCTURE:BODY:TILT CAB (8/82) (4,765 affected)
summary: THE TORSION BAR CLAMP MAY ALLOW THE TORSION BAR TO MOVE. INCREASED EFFORT WILL BE REQUIRED TO RAISE OR LOWER THE TILT CAB.

title: Harley-Davidson Motor Company: ELECTRICAL SYSTEM:ALTERNATOR:REGULATOR:STARTER:OTH (2,417 affected)
summary: PARTS IN THE ALTERNATOR MAY BREAK OFF AND CAUSE THE ALTERNATOR TO STOP FUNCTIONING, WHICH WILL ALLOW THE VEHICLE TO OPERATE ONLY UNTIL THE BATTERY IS EXHAUSTED. ALSO, SHEARED ALTERNATOR MOUNTING BOLTS MAY CAUSE THE DRIVE TRAIN AND REAR WHEEL TO LOCK UP.

title: Nissan North America, Inc.: BRAKES:HYDRAULIC:MASTER CYLINDER (11,909 affected)
summary: BRAKES MAY FAIL SUDDENLY WHEN APPLIED. COMPONENTS WITHIN THE MASTER CYLINDER MAY BE EXPELLED BECAUSE A CLIP WHICH RETAINS THEM MAY NOT BE PROPERLY INSTALLED.

title: BEATRICE FOODS COMPANY: BRAKES:VACUUM BRAKE SYSTEM:RESERVOIR (2,600 affected)
summary: THE BRAKES ARE OPERATED WITH VACUUM ASSISTANCE. THE VACUUM RESERVOIR TANK MAY DEVELOP AIR LEAKS FROM RUST DETERIORATION. THE RUST OCCURS BECAUSE THE POSITION OF THE TANK DOES NOT ALLOW PROPER DRAINAGE.

title: ARMSTRONG RUBBER CO.: TIRES:PLY (188 affected)
summary: TIRES FAILED TO MEET THE HIGH SPEED TEST REQUIREMENTS OF FEDERAL MOTOR VEHICLE SAFETY STANDARD 109, NEW PNEUMATIC TIRES. TIRES MAY DEVELOP PLY SEPARATION AT THE EDGE OF THE BELT.

title: Yokohama Tire Corporation: TIRES:PLY (1,171 affected)
summary: NON COMPLIANCE WITH FEDERAL MOTOR VEHICLE SAFETY STANDARD 109, NEW PNEUMATIC TIRES. A SEPARATION MAY DEVELOP BETWEEN THE PLIES IN THE SHOULDER OR TREAD AREA OF THE TIRE.

title: IVECO TRUCK OF N.A., INC.: BRAKES:SPRING BRAKE CHAMBER (CAN) (117 affected)
summary: CLAMP HOLDING THE TWO HALVES OF THE PARKING BRAKE CHAMBER MAY COME LOOSE OR DETACH.

title: Great Dane Trailers: EQUIPMENT:OTHER PIECES:TRAILER HITCHES AND ATTACHM (1,153 affected)
summary: THE PINTLE HOOK DOES NOT HAVE ADEQUATE REINFORCEMENT AT THE REAR MOUNTING PLATE AND CAN EVENTUALLY CRACK. PINTLE HOOK COULD COMPLETELY DISENGAGE.

title: MODERN IND. MELBOURNE INC: STEERING:POWER:SHAFT PITMAN (921 affected)
summary: INCORRECT STEEL WAS USED IN MANUFACTURE OF PITMAN SHAFT GEAR.

title: TRANSPORTATION MFG. CORP.: STEERING:POWER ASSIST:FILTER:FLUID (67 affected)
summary: FAILURE OF FILTER ELEMENT DUE TO FILTER PLUGGING CAN OCCUR, BLOCKING THE FLOW OF POWER STEERING FLUID. POWER ASSIST IN THE STEERING MAY BE LOST.

title: General Motors, LLC: BRAKES:AIR:OVER:HYDRAULIC:DISC:LINES AND FITTINGS (4,600 affected)
summary: REAR BRAKE METALLIC LINES MAY DEVELOP A CRACK AND LEAK BRAKE FLUID.

title: General Motors, LLC: SUSPENSION:SINGLE AXLE:REAR:LINES AND FITTINGS (141 affected)
summary: REAR AXLE BRAKE TEE JUNCTION BLOCK WHICH JOINS THE BRAKE LINES IN THE REAR OF THE VEHICLE, WAS PAINTED BY MISTAKE. THE PAINT COULD CAUSE LOOSENING OF THE BRAKE HOSE CONNECTION WHICH MAY RESULT IN A BRAKE FLUID LEAK AND LOSS OF REAR BRAKES.

title: General Motors, LLC: EQUIPMENT:CERTIFICATION LABEL (91 affected)
summary: OMISSION OF THE CERTIFICATION LABELS AS REQUIRED BY FEDERAL MOTOR VEHICLE SAFETY STANDARD NUMBER 110 "TIRE SELECTION AND RIMS".

title: Motor Coach Industries, Inc: STEERING:POWER ASSIST:FILTER:FLUID (207 affected)
summary: FAULTY FILTER COLLAPSES UNDER NORMAL AMOUNT OF PRESSURE. LOSS OF STEERING POWER ASSIST WILL RESULT.

title: Ford Motor Company: FUEL:FUEL SEPARATOR (8/82) (36,400 affected)
summary: WATER SEPARATOR CANISTER MAY BE PUNCTURED IN A COLLISION. CRASH TESTS IN A 30 MPH FRONTAL COLLISION REVEALED FUEL LEAKAGE EXCEEDING THE MAXIMUM PERMITTED BY FEDERAL MOTOR VEHICLE SAFETY STANDARD NO. 301, "FUEL SYSTEM INTEGRITY".

title: BEHLMANN GMC TRUCK CENTER: BRAKES:HYDRAULIC SYSTEM (92 affected)
summary: VEHICLES ORDERED WITHOUT HEAVY-DUTY BRAKES WHICH ARE NEEDED IF THE VEHICLE IS FULLY LOADED. VEHICLES DO NOT CONFORM TO FEDERAL MOTOR VEHICLE SAFETY STANDARD 105, "HYDRAULIC BRAKE SYSTEMS".

title: FIRESTONE TIRE & RUBBER CO.: TIRES:PLY (55,954 affected)
summary: TIRES FAILED TO MEET THE ENDURANCE REQUIREMENTS OF FEDERAL MOTOR VEHICLE SAFETY STANDARD NO. 109, NEW PNEUMATIC TIRES. TIRES MAY DEVELOP PLY SEPARATION.

title: Honda (American Honda Motor Co.): ELECTRICAL SYSTEM:IGNITION:SWITCH (28,750 affected)
summary: SWITCH COVER WHICH PROVIDES FOR A GOOD WIRE CONNECTION COULD BECOME LOOSE AND POSSIBLY CAUSE LOSS OF ALL ELECTRICAL FUNCTIONS.

title: General Motors, LLC: BRAKES:HYDRAULIC:MASTER CYLINDER (32,010 affected)
summary: UNWANTED AIR IS BEING DRAWN INTO THE BRAKE SYSTEM WHEN BRAKE PEDAL IS RELEASED. THIS IS DUE TO THE USE OF THE BENDIX MASTER CYLINDER IN COMBINATION WITH THE BENDIX HYDROVAC.
